datasets.name: spend
queryLines:
SELECT source, category_group, category, detail, employee_name, country, entity, spend_date, month,
  date_format(month, 'yyyy-MM') AS month_label, amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN source = 'Expense claims' THEN amount_usd END AS expense_usd,
  CASE WHEN source = 'Travel agency' THEN amount_usd END AS agency_usd,
  CASE WHEN category_group = 'Not itemised' THEN amount_usd END AS not_itemised_usd,
  CASE WHEN category IN ('Air', 'Hotel', 'Rail') THEN amount_usd END AS travel_usd,
  CASE WHEN category IN ('Air', 'Hotel', 'Rail') AND source = 'Travel agency' THEN amount_usd END AS agency_travel_usd,
  CASE WHEN source = 'Travel agency' THEN 'Booked via travel agency' ELSE 'Expensed by employees' END AS channel,
  CASE WHEN category_group = 'Not itemised' THEN 'Not itemised (expense claims)' ELSE category_group END AS spend_group,
  CASE
    WHEN source <> 'Travel agency' THEN NULL
    WHEN purpose_of_trip IS NULL THEN 'Not given'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip IN ('Client Meeting', 'Client Work', 'Site Visit') THEN 'Client'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip = 'Internal Meeting' THEN 'Internal'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip = 'Conference' THEN 'Conferences & events'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip = 'New Business' THEN 'New business'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip = 'Training' THEN 'Training'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS trip_purpose,
  purpose_of_trip, payment_method, report_id, line_basis, department,
  cc_group_2 AS cc_group_2,
  cc_group_3 AS department_group,
  CASE WHEN cc_group_3 IN (SELECT d FROM (SELECT cc_group_3 AS d, SUM(amount_usd) AS s FROM {{schema}}.spend_unified GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 10)) THEN cc_group_3 ELSE 'Other' END AS department_chart,
  team, match_method
FROM {{schema}}.spend_unified

  CASE

    WHEN purpose_of_trip IS NULL THEN 'Not given'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip IN ('Client Meeting', 'Client Work', 'Site Visit') THEN 'Client'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip = 'Internal Meeting' THEN 'Internal'
    WHEN purpose_of_trip = 'Conference' THEN 'Conferences & events'

datasets.name: top50
queryLines:
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(amount_usd) DESC) AS rank, employee_name,
  max_by(cc_group_3, amount_usd) AS department_group,
  max_by(team, amount_usd) AS team,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'Travel agency' THEN amount_usd END), 2) AS agency_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'Expense claims' THEN amount_usd END), 2) AS expense_usd,
  ROUND(SUM(amount_usd), 2) AS total_usd
FROM {{schema}}.spend_unified GROUP BY employee_name ORDER BY total_usd DESC LIMIT 50

datasets.name: people_gaps
queryLines:
SELECT employee_name,
  concat_ws(' + ', sort_array(collect_set(source))) AS sources,
  max(CASE WHEN department = 'Unmapped' THEN 'No department' END) AS department_gap,
  max(CASE WHEN team = 'Unmapped' THEN 'No team' END) AS team_gap,
  count(*) AS lines, round(sum(amount_usd), 2) AS usd
FROM {{schema}}.spend_unified
WHERE department = 'Unmapped' OR team = 'Unmapped'
GROUP BY employee_name ORDER BY usd DESC

lines:
## How the numbers are built
* **Travel agency** â newest *Travel agency bookings* file, visible Air / Hotel / Rail tabs (hidden tabs are old copies). Dated by **invoice date**; country = destination.
  * **Duplicates removed** â the September extract repeats hotel stays under the hotel group name and the brand name, and repeats some air rows.
  * **Currency corrected** â Tokyo hotel stays one October week were in yen in the USD column. Converted at 1/150 USD per yen.
* **Expense claims** â approved reports, dated by **report date**; amount = report total in USD, so it ties to the expense system. The export holds one expense line per report: the line keeps its expense type, the rest of the report is *Not itemised in export*.
* **Period** â calendar 2026 only (JanâOct). Rows dated before 2026 are left out and shown in the tie-out.
* **People** â department from the cost center the expense was charged to; travellers borrow the cost center of their own expense claims. Team from the staff mapping by employee ID, else by name. People hired after the mapping was taken show as *Unmapped*.
